page.notes: Printed page is mostly legible; the Greek lines are faint and uncertain, so the Greek passages are marked with [?] and the middle of the Dionysius line is illegible. "Set" in the first dialogue line, the apostrophe in "diu'" and the spelling "commendanit" are copied as printed. The last line ends mid-phrase ("diacopos sive") and is a full line, so no catchword is given. Greek accents in the Hesychius line are unreliable.
